rubric_items.reason: All 11 design components, including the existing ones, have at least one threat row (T-1..T-13). That covers the components that handle personal data: AppointmentsPage, the appointment table and DoctorService.
Most threats are specific to HMS-7: the window drift, the dashboard regression, the PATCH round-trip and the dropped doctorId filter. T-1 and T-8 overlap on HOSPITAL_TZ, and T-12 is fairly generic.

Each threat is marked as an existing or a new control, and new controls are listed for implement. A few existing controls rest on statements that are not cited, such as closed appointments never changing and the id already being parsed as an integer.
The one real gap, how fromDoctor and PATCH handle unknown fields, is recorded as U-1 and Q-01 with options and a default. Nothing is assumed silently.
The model is clear and the summary matches the frontmatter, but the threats are listed in component order, not by risk.
